# Generated GLAD2 loader

These files were generated from official [GLAD2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad)
version `v2.0.8`, commit `73db193f853e2ee079bf3ca8a64aa2eaf6459043`.

Generator configuration:

- language: C;
- API: `gl:core=3.3`;
- extensions: none;
- built-in platform loader: enabled;
- reproducible mode: enabled.

Equivalent generator arguments are:

```text
--api gl:core=3.3 --extensions <empty-file> --reproducible c --loader
```

The generated loader is committed so configuring the C++ project does not
require Python or Jinja2. See `LICENSE` and the SPDX identifiers in the
generated files for the applicable licenses.
